name: Spoken-list tags: the stack
when: The voice lists 2 to 4 short things in one breath over rolling footage ("rooftop bars, nightclubs, car meets and packed beaches"; "every trailer, every interview, every preview"; "hunting, fishing and off-road trails"). Each thing lands as a solid tag on its word, into a stack on the title-safe edge (x 120, or x 1800 on the right), one under the other; the footage keeps running and cutting under it and the stack holds still across the cuts, then everything leaves together after the last thing. Unlike split2-C, the footage never stops: use this one when the shots under the list run on (2 or 3 cuts), and for things footage can't show (trailers, interviews). Put the stack in the corner away from faces and from any game HUD the shots show (shot-index `hud`): the tags are solid, so any footage behind them works. One or two words per tag, as the voice says them, sentence case; nothing else on screen with it.
anchor: at1 to at4: each tag lands on the word that names its thing (the start of that word in words.json). Start the scene a few frames before the first thing (at1 about 0.2). The scene ends 0.23 s after `out`.
placement: Over the footage, across its cuts: the scene's start and end don't need to sit on cuts. Hold at least 1 s after the last tag lands before `out`.

vars.theme: clean (white tags, ink letters) or vice (ink letters on marigold to flamingo tags that share one ramp across the stack, so a shorter tag stops partway along it): the video's theme
vars.item1: the first thing, as the voice says it: one or two words (Rooftop bars), sentence case, 18 characters at most. Drop the article ("the swamps" -> Swamps) and "and"
vars.item2: the second thing, the same way
vars.item3: the third thing; empty = a list of two
vars.item4: the fourth thing; empty = a list of three or less. Five things or more: show the four the voice stresses, or use another animation
vars.at1: seconds after the start: when the voice says the first thing (its first word). Keep it about 0.2 so the scene opens just before it
vars.at2: seconds after the start: when the voice says the second thing. Each thing at least 0.4 s after the previous one; a time that isn't after the previous one (or 0 on a later item) lands it 0.5 s after the previous one
vars.at3: the same for the third thing (ignored when item3 is empty)
vars.at4: the same for the fourth thing (ignored when item4 is empty)
vars.corner: where the stack sits: bottom-left (default: stacked up from y 960, on x 120), top-left (down from y 120), bottom-right or top-right (right-aligned on x 1800). Pick the corner with no face and no game HUD in any of the shots under it, ideally next to what the shots show
vars.out: seconds after the start: when all the tags leave together (the scene ends 0.23 s later); at least 1 s after the last thing's time

source: new, built in the skills repo (lot 6, 17 Nov 2026). Demo: algrow-gta-pipeline/lab/listtags/. Its tag is keyword-A2's validated chip (white or gradient fill, ink letters, its shadows) at 50 px, with the source box's validated entry (caption5-A: fade, 16 px rise, a hair of scale, 11 frames).
